Some of the city's most unsavory guilds have been known to assign thugs to this corridor, who lie in wait to ambush unsuspecting passersby on their way to the temple. }} This area functions as a lobby for organizing parties and includes convenient access portals to [[Elite Mission]]s. ==Getting there== Completion of the mission [[Tahnnakai Temple]] brings [[character]]s here. ==Quests available== *[[Emperor's Voice]] **[[A Meeting With the Emperor]] {{quest icon|primary}} **[[The Count's Daughter]] {{quest icon|primary}} ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{x}} 10 [[Adept Bishu]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Soul Stone]]s) *{{x}} 10 [[Dai Waeng]] (collector for 5 [[Pulsating Growth]]s) *{{x}} 20 [[Buhraa]] ([[weaponsmith]]) *{{x}} 20 [[Lo Ying]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 10 [[Tombo]] ([[skill trainer]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) ====Henchmen==== :''(all level 20)'' *{{w}} [[Devona]] (Fighter) *{{w}} [[Talon Silverwing]] (Fighter) *{{r}} [[Aidan]] (Archer) *{{r}} [[Zho]] (Archer) *{{mo}} [[Jamei]] (Healer) *{{mo}} [[Sister Tai]] (Healer) *{{n}} [[Eve]] (Cultist) *{{n}} [[Su]] (Vile) *{{me}} [[Lo Sha]] (Illusion) *{{e}} [[Cynn]] (Mage) *{{e}} [[Headmaster Vhang]] (Shock) *{{e}} [[Kai Ying]] (Earth) *{{a}} [[Emi]] (Cutthroat) *{{a}} [[Nika]] (Deadly) *{{a}} [[Panaku]] (Cutthroat) *{{rt}} [[Chiyo]] (Spirit) *{{rt}} [[Professor Gai]] (Spirit) ====Other allies==== *{{x}} 10 [[Bihah the Scribe]] *{{x}} 20 [[Emperor's Voice]] *{{x}} 10 [[Resongkai]] *{{x}} 10 [[Temple Acolyte]]s == Notes == * This outpost fulfills the same functions as [[Temple of the Ages]] does in ''[[Guild Wars Prophecies]]'' and the [[Chantry of Secrets]] does in ''[[Guild Wars Nightfall]]''; it is the only Factions outpost that allows entry to [[the Underworld]] or [[the Fissure of Woe]]. * When you enter, you are shown the current [[Favor of the Gods]], as if you used the ''/favor'' [[emote]]. * This outpost has some rats running along the ground. {{anomaly|If a party enters Zin Ku Corridor from Sunjiang District, they will end up in front of the exit to Tahnnakai Temple, on the other side of the outpost.}} {{Towns and outposts in Kaineng City}}
